comment: Curated infrastructure-dependency registry. When the dependency rule fires (a described component is self-hosted infrastructure — a database, cache, or broker — rather than the developer's own code), chartpress emits an umbrella Chart.yaml dependencies: entry from THIS table instead of a generated subchart. Version-pinned and frozen per release like the pattern registry; each pin carries a review-version TODO in the generated output so the freeze never ships stale software silently. Keys are the closed set text-to-config may emit; anything not here degrades to a stub entry with TODO markers.
